name: scrape_config
lifecycle: created atomically on enqueue; removed when the final queue/lease/deadletter drains

name: board_config
lifecycle: one hash per configured board; removed by sync when disabled/retired

name: scrape_queue_first
lifecycle: first scrape; claim moves the item to inflight

name: scrape_queue_recurring
lifecycle: recurring scrape; claim moves the item to inflight

name: monitor_queue_first
lifecycle: initial board monitor; claim moves the item to inflight

name: monitor_queue_recurring
lifecycle: recurring board monitor; claim moves the item to inflight

name: ready_queue
lifecycle: six fixed tier indexes plus two recurring-scrape rotation indexes

name: inflight
lifecycle: two fixed lease sets; heartbeat, completion, reschedule, or reaper removes entries

name: inflight_strikes
lifecycle: retry counter cleared on completion; poison tasks move to deadletter

name: deadletter
lifecycle: poison leases retained until explicit retry/prune

name: delay
lifecycle: one domain throttle value; overwritten whenever domain work is enqueued

name: host_circuit
lifecycle: failure/open/probe state expires after the configured recovery window

name: provider_circuit
lifecycle: incident host/open/probe state expires after the configured recovery window

name: other
lifecycle: unclassified keys must be assigned before becoming material
